title: Honey Cake
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add eggs,sugar & whisk well for a minute.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein anday aur cheeni dal ker ek minute kliya ache tarhan whisk ker lein.
-Vanilla essence & honey dal ker ache tarhan whisk karein.

steps.instruction: -Add butter & place the bowl on double boiler,whisk continuously & cook on low flame until butter melts (approx. 4-5 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Makhan dal dein aur bowl ko double boiler mein rakh dein,musalsal whisk kertay rahein aur halki ancch per makhan melt ho janay tak paka lein (approx. 4-5 minutes).

steps.instruction: -Remove bowl from double boiler,add baking soda & whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl ko double boiler sa hata mein aur baking soda dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Gradually add all-purpose flour,mix well & gather the dough.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thora thora ker ka maida shamil karein aur mix ker ka dough bana lein.

steps.instruction: -Transfer the dough on a clean working surface & knead until smooth dough is formed then divide the dough into 9 portions.
steps.romanUrdu: -Dough ko clean workings surface per rakh dein aur dough ko smooth hunay tak ghond lein phir 9 portions mein divide ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take one small dough (130g) & make a ball,place dough ball on baking paper & roll out with the help of rolling pin & cut with the help of 6-inch cake cutter & prick with fork.Repeat the same process to make 6-8 sheets.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek chota dough (130g) lein aur ball bana lein,dough ko baking paper rakh dein aur rolling pi ki madad sa bail lein aur 6-inch cake cutter ki madad sa cut ker ka fork sa prick ker lein.Yehe process ker ka 6-8 sheets tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Preheated oven mein 180C per 10 minutes kliya bake ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take out from oven & trim edges of each rolled dough.
steps.romanUrdu: -Oven sa nikal lein aur edges ko trim ker lein.

steps.instruction: -In a chopper,add reserved cake scrapes,chop until crumbles & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cake layers ko bad mein use kernay kliya side per rakh dein.
-Chopper mein reserved cake scrapes dal dein aur crumble hunay tak ache tarhan chop ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add cream,lemon juice & whisk well for 30 seconds.Sour cream is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein cream aur lemon juice dal dein aur 30 seconds kliya ache tarhan whisk ker lein.Sour cream tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add whipping cream & beat until soft peaks form.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein whipping cream dal dein aur soft peaks form ho janay tak ache tarhan beat ker lein.
-Vanilla essence & honey dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein.
-Sour cream dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a small bowl,add sugar,water,mix well until sugar is dissolved & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chotay bowl mein cheeni aur pani dal dein aur cheeni ghul janay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -Place cake layer on a butter paper around on serving plate.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cake layer ko butter paper ka upper rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -Apply sugar syrup & frosting on each cake layer.
steps.romanUrdu: -Sugar syrup & frosting ko her cake layer per laga lein.

steps.instruction: -Repeat with all cake layer,frost top & sides of cake & cover with crumbs.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cake ka upper & sides per frost laga lein aur crumbs sa cover ker lein.
